title: Mobile action definition
description: One file in actions/. `summary` is the one line the assistant sees when it lists the actions; `description`, `params`, `result` and `errors` are what it reads when it asks for one action's details. `maintainer_notes` never reach the assistant. Inside `params` and `result`, `{ "$shared": "<name>" }` stands for a fragment from actions/_shared.yaml.

name.description: Stable id in snake_case; the file is actions/<name>.yaml. Never renamed once released.

title.description: A short label (for logs and admin screens).

summary.description: One line: what the action does and when to use it.

description.description: Instructions for the assistant: when to use it, how to fill the parameters, what the phone does, what comes back. No personal or company data.

since.description: The contract version that introduced the action. An app that implements an older version is never offered it.

deprecated.description: Set when the action should no longer be offered; says what to use instead.

reports_result.description: true: the phone always reports the outcome back to the assistant. false: it does not report a success (for example, it only opens a screen).

result.description: JSON Schema (draft-07) of `data` in a successful result. Required when `reports_result` is true.

errors.description: The failure codes the phone reports in `data.code`.

data.description: Extra fields the failure carries, as a JSON Schema `properties` map.

says.description: What the rep said, for context.

maintainer_notes.description: Open questions and app-side details for the people who maintain the contract. Not shown to the assistant.
